events.description: Two players engage in mutual physical combat: a Florida Panthers player (white jersey, #5) and a Montreal Canadiens player (red jersey, #13, DOMI) grapple and exchange punches near the boards, with a referee intervening.

Two players (one in red/blue Montreal Canadiens jersey, one in white Vegas Golden Knights jersey) are engaged in a physical altercation near the boards, with referees intervening to separate them. The fight involves grappling and pushing against the glass.

After the initial fight is broken up, a player in the red/blue jersey (No. 92, Drouin) appears to strike or push a downed opponent (No. 5, in white/gold jersey) who is on the ice and being restrained by referees. The downed player is clearly helpless while the standing player makes contact.

Two players (one in red/blue Montreal Canadiens jersey #13, one in white/black jersey #5) are engaged in a physical altercation on the ice, with referees intervening to separate them. The struggle involves grappling and pushing while both are on the ice or partially upright.

After being separated, the player in the red/blue jersey (#13, Domi) appears to deliver a punch or strike to the head/face of the downed opponent (#5), who is still on the ice and being restrained by a referee. The opponent is in a vulnerable, supine position.

A player in a white jersey (No. 5, 'ENGRLAND') is lying on the ice, seemingly injured or incapacitated, while a referee (No. 61) kneels beside him and another player (Montreal's Domi, No. 13) stands nearby with hands on hips; no active combat, but the prone player appears helpless and is being attended to, consistent with aftermath of an abusive act (e.g., illegal check or hit from behind).

Initial physical engagement: Domi (No. 13, red) is held by two referees while another player (white jersey, No. 5) is on the ice; the positioning suggests a recent or ongoing scuffle involving multiple players before full separation. The contact between Domi and the downed player is not clearly visible as mutual combat, but the referees’ immediate intervention and Domi’s restrained posture suggest a prior fight.

Player #5 (Ekblad) is engaged in a physical altercation with an opponent; visible contact includes the opponent’s arm across Ekblad’s chest/shoulder and Ekblad’s raised hand near the opponent’s head/face area, consistent with active combat.

After initial engagement, Ekblad appears dazed and injured (blood on face), while an opponent’s skate is positioned near his head/upper body (visible in f3–f4); the referee intervenes at f2, suggesting the player is no longer actively defending himself, making subsequent contact potentially abusive.

Ekblad, now visibly bleeding and disoriented, is being assisted off the ice by staff; however, prior frames (f9–f10) show him still near the boards with another individual in close proximity and apparent physical interaction—suggesting residual or renewed combat before full removal.
